core_obligations: From assumptions (1) and (2) of the lemma, $\mathcal{P}$ is stable under precomposing with \'etale morphisms (lemma-precompose-property-local-source) and under smooth base change (lemma-pullback-property-local-target); hence it suffices to verify part (3) of definition-local-source-target (proof lines 3324-3338).

Set up the part (3)(b) data: for every $x \in X$ a smooth morphism $b_x : V_x \to Y$, an \'etale morphism $U_x \to V_x \times_Y X$ with a point $u_x$ over $x$, and $h_x : U_x \to V_x$ with $\mathcal{P}$ (proof lines 3339-3350).

Form the coproduct diagram with $U = \coprod U_x \to V = \coprod V_x$ over $f$: $b$ smooth, $U \to V \times_Y X$ \'etale, $a$ surjective, and $h$ has $\mathcal{P}$ because $\mathcal{P}$ is smooth local on the target (proof lines 3351-3362).

Run the four-step scheme reduction: make $X$ a scheme via a surjective \'etale $X' \to X$ with $U' = X' \times_X U$ (\'etale-locality on the source), make $Y$ a scheme via a surjective \'etale $Y' \to Y$ (smooth-locality on the target), make $V$ a scheme via a surjective \'etale $V' \to V$ with $U' = U \times_V V'$ (smooth-locality on the source), and finally make $U$ a scheme by surjective \'etale replacement (proof lines 3363-3390).
Conclude $f$ has $\mathcal{P}$ by the scheme-side Descent lemma (proof lines 3390-3391).
proof_roadmap: Convert the two localities into stability properties and isolate the remaining part (3) of the definition.
Glue the local witnesses into one commutative diagram by coproducts.
Reduce all four spaces to schemes, one step per assumed locality.
difficulty_reason: The proof assembles a global diagram by taking coproducts of the local data, then runs an explicit four-step reduction (make $X$, $Y$, $V$, $U$ schemes in turn, each step justified by one of the three assumed localities) before applying the scheme-side descent criterion. The bookkeeping of which locality justifies which reduction step is the substance.
